items.raw_excerpt: Flowing beautifully through the heart of the Templar city of Tomar, the Rio Nabão is currently undergoing an environmental revival.
items.summary_en: Workers and volunteers are cleaning the Rio Nabao river in Tomar, a Templar town in Portugal. The river is getting an environmental revival after years of neglect. The cleanup aims to bring the water and local life back to the river.

items.title_en: Cleaning Up the Rio Nabao River in Tomar

items.summary_en: A new painting of Krotoa was unveiled in Cape Town this week. Krotoa was a Khoi woman who worked as a language interpreter at the Cape. The painting was shown at events for Heritage Day, a South African national holiday.

items.raw_excerpt: Macklemore has announced a Dublin concert as part of his new Free Palestine Tour, following his removal from the remaining dates of Ed Sheeran's US tour earlier this month.
items.summary_en: American rapper Macklemore has added a Dublin concert to his new Free Palestine Tour. He was dropped from the rest of Ed Sheeran's US tour earlier this month. Fans in Ireland can now book tickets for the new Dublin date.

items.raw_excerpt: A former government building in Lisbon is set to be turned into around 90 homes, most of them one-bedroom properties aimed at public-sector workers struggling to find affordable accommodation in the capital.
items.summary_en: A former government building in Lisbon will be turned into about 90 new homes. Most of them are small one-bedroom flats for public workers. The city has very few cheap homes near the center, so many workers commute from far away.

items.title_en: Old Government Office in Lisbon Becomes 90 Homes

items.summary_en: Gray Village Hardware in Gray, Maine, was named Maine's 2026 HBSDealer All Star. The award honors stores with good service, wide product range, and care for their community. The shop is a family business serving the southern Maine area.

items.raw_excerpt: The Portuguese Society for the Study of Birds (SPEA) is promoting a blackout in Madeira on 27 September to protect the Madeira petrel, a seabird endemic to the region that is threatened, it was announced.
items.summary_en: People in Madeira will turn off outdoor lights for one hour on 27 September. The dark helps the Madeira petrel, a seabird found only on this island. The bird is in danger, so people are asked to keep lights off at night.
items.summary_ko: 9월 27일 마델라에서는 야외 조명을 한 시간 동안 끄는 소등 행사가 열립니다. 이 섬에서만 사는 바다새 마델라 페트렐이 빛을 피해 헤매지 않도록 하는 것이 목적입니다. 이 새가 위급한 상황이기에 밤에는 조명을 켜지 말아 달라는 요청도 함께 내려옵니다.
items.title_en: Madeira to turn off lights to help a rare seabird
items.title_ko: 조명 소등으로 새를 돕는 마델라
items.title_original: Scheduled blackout in Madeira to protect birds

items.summary_en: The Professional Women's Hockey League will hold its first all-star game in Toronto on March 7. The game is part of the league's fourth season and brings its top players together in one place.

items.raw_excerpt: Iceland's Supreme Court has awarded damages over deficient implementation of EEA rules that reduced a returning worker's maternity-leave payments.
items.summary_en: Iceland's top court ruled that the state broke EEA rules on maternity leave pay. The gap left a woman who came back to work with less money. The court awarded her damages.

items.raw_excerpt: El escritor valenciano que cambió Madrid por un pueblo de la Hoya de Buñol, abrió una librería y encontró allí lo que andaba buscando.
items.summary_en: Maximo Huerta, a writer from Valencia, left the city and opened a small bookshop in a quiet village in the Hoya de Buñol area. The village has an old Arab castle. He says the place is the best place to be happy.

items.raw_excerpt: For many travellers, a trip abroad means visiting famous landmarks, museums or trying the restaurants recommended by locals.
items.summary_en: More travellers now visit local supermarkets during holidays instead of famous landmarks or museums. They buy everyday food and snacks to eat like locals and spend less money. Local shop owners say they welcome these new visitors.
